title: Mansmann letters describe domed disc on film

tellings.quote: Florence mansman analyzed the film frame by frame with a magnifier what's called a loop magnifier and he's on record by the mid 80s he was writing to Jacobs in private letters saying what I saw with the magnifier was a disc-shaped object with a dome

plain: A film shot at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California in 1964 showed a disc-shaped object with a dome, according to private letters written by a man named Florenze Mansmann, who had studied the film. The researcher Robert Hastings, who writes about UFOs seen over nuclear weapons sites, says Mansmann went through the film frame by frame with a loupe, a small magnifying lens, and by the mid-1980s was writing to a man named Robert Jacobs that "what I saw with the magnifier was a disc-shaped object with a dome." If true, it would mean a military camera caught a built craft on film.
